sideB.summary: DID NOT DELIVER: 851 AND ABOVE. The world is saved, but not the Faded. Utopia has the cure at JADE, will produce it, and will not give it to them. The Hollow Men are free. The Faded will not see the new world and hope to be remembered as its saviors. DID NOT DELIVER: 701-850. Some cities are saved and civilization is rekindled, while Utopia and the Hollow Men are at war. One of them may take the sample to JADE and start a cure, and neither is expected to share it. The Faded kept the world going after everyone else quit.
sideB.text:
DID NOT DELIVER: 851 AND ABOVE
We saved the world, just not ourselves. The 21st century will be remembered as a time of darkness but there is now light ahead. Utopia has the cure and will now produce it at JADE. They just won’t give it to us. The Hollow Men have been freed. The Faded won’t be here to see this new world but we hope that history will remember us as its saviors.

DID NOT DELIVER: 701-850
We have persevered. Some cities were saved. Civilization has been rekindled. Utopia and the Hollow Men are at war with each other. One of them will bring the sample to JADE and start producing a cure. We don’t expect either to share it with us. All we know is that we kept the world going when everyone else had given up.
